f3_program: collection("publishing_house.contest.prizes", "award", "publishing_house.contest", source("will award a total of $800 in prizes to the 18 novels with the most votes"))
observe(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.count", "future"), 18, "count", source("the 18 novels with the most votes"))
observe(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.total.amount", "future"), 800, "currency", source("a total of $800 in prizes"))
partition("publishing_house.contest.prizes", at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.total.amount", "future"), source("award a total of $800 in prizes to the 18 novels with the most votes"))
member("publishing_house.contest.prizes", "publishing_house.contest.prizes.first", source("First place"))
observe(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.first.amount", "future"), 200, "currency", source("First place will get $200"))
member("publishing_house.contest.prizes", "publishing_house.contest.prizes.second", source("second place"))
observe(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.second.amount", "future"), 150, "currency", source("second place will get $150"))
member("publishing_house.contest.prizes", "publishing_house.contest.prizes.third", source("third place"))
observe(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.third.amount", "future"), 120, "currency", source("third place $120"))
collection("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward", "award", "publishing_house.contest.prizes", source("the rest of the awards"))

offset(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.count", "future"), at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.count", "future"), -3, "count", source("the 18 novels with the most votes. First place will get $200, second place will get $150, third place $120 and the rest of the awards"))

same(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.member.amount", "future"), at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.common.amount", "future"), source("the rest of the awards will be paid with the same amount of money"))

product_relation(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.total.amount", "future"), at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.count", "future"), at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.common.amount", "future"), source("the rest of the awards will be paid with the same amount of money"))

sum_relation(at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.total.amount", "future"), at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.first.amount", "future"), at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.second.amount", "future"), at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.third.amount", "future"), at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.total.amount", "future"), source("a total of $800 in prizes to the 18 novels with the most votes. First place will get $200, second place will get $150, third place $120 and the rest of the awards will be paid with the same amount of money"))
query("value", at("publishing_house.contest.prizes.fourth_onward.common.amount", "future"))
collection("farmer.hog.piglets", "piglet", "farmer.hog", source("a hog that recently gave birth to 6 piglets"))
produce("piglet_birth", "farmer.hog", at("farmer.hog.piglets.count", "current"), 6, source("gave birth to 6 piglets"))
observe(at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_price", "current"), 300, "currency_per_pig", source("sell the fully grown pig for $300"))
observe(at("farmer.hog.piglets.minimum_growth_duration", "current"), 12, "month", source("Each piglet must grow for at least 12 months before it is large enough to be sold"))
observe(at("farmer.hog.piglets.feed_cost_rate", "current"), 10, "currency_per_animal_month", source("It costs the farmer $10 per month to feed each animal until it is sold"))
remove("sale_after_12_months", "farmer", at("farmer.hog.piglets.count", "current"), 3, source("the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months"))
observe(at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_12_months.growth_duration", "after_12_months"), 12, "month", source("sells 3 pigs after 12 months"))
remove("sale_after_16_months", "farmer", at("farmer.hog.piglets.count", "current"), 3, source("the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months, and the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months"))
observe(at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_16_months.growth_duration", "after_16_months"), 16, "month", source("the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months"))

product_relation(at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_12_months.revenue.amount", "after_12_months"), event_field("sale_after_12_months", "quantity"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_price", "current"), source("he can sell the fully grown pig for $300.  Each piglet must grow for at least 12 months before it is large enough to be sold. It costs the farmer $10 per month to feed each animal until it is sold.  If the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months"))

product_relation(at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_16_months.revenue.amount", "after_16_months"), event_field("sale_after_16_months", "quantity"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_price", "current"), source("he can sell the fully grown pig for $300.  Each piglet must grow for at least 12 months before it is large enough to be sold. It costs the farmer $10 per month to feed each animal until it is sold.  If the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months, and the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months"))

product_relation(at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_12_months.food_cost.amount", "after_12_months"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.feed_cost_rate", "current"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_12_months.growth_duration", "after_12_months"), event_field("sale_after_12_months", "quantity"), source("It costs the farmer $10 per month to feed each animal until it is sold.  If the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months"))

product_relation(at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_16_months.food_cost.amount", "after_16_months"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.feed_cost_rate", "current"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_16_months.growth_duration", "after_16_months"), event_field("sale_after_16_months", "quantity"), source("It costs the farmer $10 per month to feed each animal until it is sold.  If the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months, and the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months"))

sum_relation(at("farmer.hog.piglets.sales.revenue.total.amount", "after_16_months"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_12_months.revenue.amount", "after_12_months"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_16_months.revenue.amount", "after_16_months"), source("the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months, and the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months, how much profit did he earn in total"))

sum_relation(at("farmer.hog.piglets.food_cost.total.amount", "after_16_months"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_12_months.food_cost.amount", "after_12_months"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.sale_after_16_months.food_cost.amount", "after_16_months"), source("the farmer sells 3 pigs after 12 months, and the remaining 3 pigs after 16 months, how much profit did he earn in total (after deducting the cost of food)"))

difference_relation(at("farmer.hog.piglets.profit.total.amount", "after_16_months"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.sales.revenue.total.amount", "after_16_months"), at("farmer.hog.piglets.food_cost.total.amount", "after_16_months"), source("how much profit did he earn in total (after deducting the cost of food)"))
query("value", at("farmer.hog.piglets.profit.total.amount", "after_16_months"))
collection("global_gym.gyms", "gym", "global_gym", source("They have 20 gyms"))
observe(at("global_gym.gyms.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("They have 20 gyms"))
collection("global_gym.cardio_machines", "cardio_machine", "global_gym.gyms", source("all of its cardio machines"))
observe(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.bike.count_per_gym", "current"), 10, "count", source("Each gym has 10 bikes"))
observe(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.treadmill.count_per_gym", "current"), 5, "count", source("5 treadmills"))
observe(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.elliptical_machine.count_per_gym", "current"), 5, "count", source("5 elliptical machines"))
observe(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.bike.unit_cost", "current"), 700, "currency", source("The bikes cost $700 each"))
percent_more(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.treadmill.unit_cost", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.bike.unit_cost", "current"), 50, source("The treadmills cost 50% more than that"))

multiple(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.elliptical_machine.unit_cost", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.treadmill.unit_cost", "current"), 2, source("The elliptical machines are twice as expensive as the treadmills"))

product_relation(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.bike.replacement_cost_per_gym", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.bike.count_per_gym", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.bike.unit_cost", "current"), source("Each gym has 10 bikes, 5 treadmills, and 5 elliptical machines.  The bikes cost $700 each"))

product_relation(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.treadmill.replacement_cost_per_gym", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.treadmill.count_per_gym", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.treadmill.unit_cost", "current"), source("Each gym has 10 bikes, 5 treadmills, and 5 elliptical machines.  The bikes cost $700 each.  The treadmills cost 50% more than that"))

product_relation(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.elliptical_machine.replacement_cost_per_gym", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.elliptical_machine.count_per_gym", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.elliptical_machine.unit_cost", "current"), source("Each gym has 10 bikes, 5 treadmills, and 5 elliptical machines.  The bikes cost $700 each.  The treadmills cost 50% more than that.  The elliptical machines are twice as expensive as the treadmills"))

sum_relation(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.replacement_cost_per_gym", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.bike.replacement_cost_per_gym", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.treadmill.replacement_cost_per_gym", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.elliptical_machine.replacement_cost_per_gym", "current"), source("Each gym has 10 bikes, 5 treadmills, and 5 elliptical machines.  The bikes cost $700 each.  The treadmills cost 50% more than that.  The elliptical machines are twice as expensive as the treadmills.  How much does it cost to replace everything"))

product_relation(at("global_gym.cardio_machines.total_replacement_cost", "current"), at("global_gym.gyms.count", "current"), at("global_gym.cardio_machines.replacement_cost_per_gym", "current"), source("They have 20 gyms.  Each gym has 10 bikes, 5 treadmills, and 5 elliptical machines.  The bikes cost $700 each.  The treadmills cost 50% more than that.  The elliptical machines are twice as expensive as the treadmills.  How much does it cost to replace everything"))
query("value", at("global_gym.cardio_machines.total_replacement_cost", "current"))
